headline: Going Commando's USA v1.01 rises from 90.31% to 91.80% of code matched
summary: Going Commando's progress report puts USA v1.01 at 91.80% of code matched, up from 90.31%, with 8,173 of 8,584 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Three direct batches supplied matching C for 60 functions, alongside merged work on Joba, Gorn and Damosel.
highlights: #419 adds matching C for the Joba sentry and a shared boss bar, while retaining findings on other Joba state machines.
#422 matches two USA v1.01 functions, covering a Gorn cutscene controller and a Damosel effect trigger, and carries 18 PAL-only functions into C.
#423 matches 16 functions present in USA v1.01 and repairs reload and padding accounting.
A separate progress commit reports 7,242 of 8,677 matched functions for PAL and 7,932 of 8,639 for USA v2.00.
Further small-function, sky-rendering and PAL batches opened as #424, #425 and #426. None had merged, and some original-assembly classifications in #424 still need review.
